summary: Python-based educational implementation of K-Means and Maximin clustering algorithms for pattern recognition, featuring an interactive CLI, vectorized computations, and iterative convergence visualization.
key_features: Interactive CLI for dataset and cluster configuration
K-Means with convergence detection via np.allclose
Maximin algorithm with dynamic cluster determination
Vectorized distance calculations using NumPy broadcasting
Matplotlib visualization of iterative convergence and final clusters
Educational design for pattern recognition laboratory exercises
achievements: Optimized distance matrix computations using NumPy broadcasting to handle up to 100,000 data points efficiently, mitigating O(n×k) memory constraints. Implemented dynamic cluster discovery in the Maximin algorithm via adaptive distance thresholding. Engineered precise convergence detection for K-Means using np.allclose, eliminating redundant iterations. Built an interactive CLI with real-time iterative visualization to demonstrate algorithmic behavior for educational purposes.
